Deja atemperar 5 minutos 🔹️ Mientras pon en un bol los huevos y el azúcar y bate con unas varillas hasta que espumen. Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. Molten Chocolate Lava Cake  Ingredients: - 1/2 cup unsalted butter - 6oz semi-sweet or bittersweet chocolate, chopped - 2 large eggs - 2 large egg yolks - 1 tsp vanilla extract - 1/4 cup sugar - 1/4 tsp salt - 2 tbsp flour - 1 tsp espresso powder Bake at 450 F for 8-10 minutes in ramekins Makes 4-6 servings (depends on ramekin size) Instructions: Grease your ramekins well and dust  them with a little flour or cocoa powder. Melt the butter and  chopped chocolate together until  completely smooth over a double boiler. Or you can do this in the microwave in  short intervals, stirring between each one. In a separate bowl, whisk together  the eggs, egg yolks, sugar, vanilla, and  salt. Whisk until everything is smooth  and slightly thicker and lighter in color. The extra egg yolks help give the lava  cake a richer, more custardy center. Add the flour and espresso powder into chocolate mixture, and mix just until  combined. The espresso powder isn’t there to  make it taste like coffee—it just helps  enhance the chocolate flavor.  Slowly pour the melted chocolate mixture  into the egg mixture and whisk until  smooth, but make sure not to overmix. Divide the batter evenly between  four to six ramekins, depending on  their size. Bake at 450°F for about 8 to 10 minutes. The edges should be set, but the centers  should still look slightly soft and jiggly. And this is where you really don’t want  to overbake them. Let them rest for a minute, then carefully  flip them onto a plate. #chocolate #cake #dessert #easyrecipe #easydessert
